svg.title: All three coefficients are positive: for k = 0 their weights are cp, cp, c, and for k = 1, 2 positivity follows from faithfulness. Therefore every F0k has rank two on P. For j = 1, 2 and each nonzero input vector x, strict Choi positivity on C3 ⊗Qj implies ⟨x|Φ∗ j(Ek)|x⟩> 0 whenever the compression of Ek to Qj is nonzero and positive semidefinite. That compression is faithful for k = 1, 2, and nonzero rank one for k = 0. Hence all six Fjk are faithful. Finally the Choi supports of the three classically recorded branches are orthogonal, so their ranks sum to 3 + 6 + 6 = 15.
